# WDF1 Portfolio with Custom Domain

Build a polished portfolio site locally, then prepare it for static hosting and
custom-domain deployment.

## Outcomes

- work in a file-based front-end project rather than a playground
- use npm scripts and a local dev server
- design a responsive portfolio layout
- prepare a site for static hosting and custom-domain publishing
